citations.A1: Cache is never invalidated when file changes on disk — check file modification time and reload if mtime is newer than cached-load time.
citations.A2: TTL timer: reloads only after a timeout expires, not when the file actually changes.
citations.A3: External invalidation function: requires caller coordination; does not auto-detect changes.
citations.A4: Path parameter is ignored after the first call — use `path` as part of the cache key
